subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the exact v1.11 Codex Action and the grouped third-party workflow-action revisions in credential-bearing CI and release jobs after exact-head workflow evidence is available?
rationale: The patch updates immutable third-party action code at several secrets and publishing boundaries; the repository’s protected security signal requires an accountable maintainer decision rather than an automated cleanup outcome.

options.title: Approve after exact-head evidence
options.body: Review the pinned revisions and accept the PR after redacted exact-head workflow output covers the Codex, app-token, and release/security paths.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Land lower-risk action revisions separately and hold the Codex, token, release, and Docker action updates for focused security review.

options.title: Pause the group update
options.body: Close or defer this grouped bump if the repository cannot currently produce enough protected-workflow evidence for the changed actions.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head evidence
recommendation.body: Review the pinned revisions and accept the PR after redacted exact-head workflow output covers the Codex, app-token, and release/security paths.

likelyOwner.reason: These owners control the repository workflows that receive secrets and publish artifacts.
